# hanoryx-components — full catalogue

## Interface kit

### Calendar (kit/inputs)
import { Calendar } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A single-date calendar with roving focus, min/max bounds, month navigation and locale-aware labels.
props: label='Choose a date', value, defaultValue='', onChange, min, max, disabled=false, locale='en', weekStartsOn=0, today=formatDate(new Date())

### Checkbox (kit/inputs)
import { Checkbox } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A checkbox with room for a hint. It is a real input — the square is drawn beside it — and it supports the indeterminate “some of them” state of a parent box.
props: label, hint, checked, defaultChecked, onChange, indeterminate=false, disabled, className, ...rest

### Combobox (kit/inputs)
import { Combobox } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
An editable combobox: type to filter, move through the matches with the arrow keys, choose with Enter. Focus stays in the input; the highlighted option is named with aria-activedescendant.
props: label, hint, error, required, options=[], value, defaultValue='', onChange, onSelect, placeholder='Type to search…', emptyText="Nothing matches.", className, disabled

### DateInput (kit/inputs)
import { DateInput } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Labelled native date input, plus local time, local date/time and paired date-range controls.
props: label='Date', ...props

### TimeInput (kit/inputs)
import { TimeInput } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Local civil time, with no timezone conversion. onChange receives the native event.
props: label='Time', ...props

### DateTimeInput (kit/inputs)
import { DateTimeInput } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Local date and time. The host owns timezone selection and conversion.
props: label='Date and time', ...props

### DateRangeInput (kit/inputs)
import { DateRangeInput } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A labelled pair. No partial selection is discarded; a reversed range is explained.
props: label='Date range', value={ start: '', end: '' }, onChange, min, max, disabled=false, required=false

### Field (kit/inputs)
import { Field } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
The label, hint and error that every field shares, wired up so a screen reader hears them. The control you put inside it receives its id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
props: label, hint, error, required=false, id, className, labelExtra, children

### FileDrop (kit/inputs)
import { FileDrop } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A drop zone that is also a file button: drag files onto it, or press it and choose. It lists what was picked and uploads nothing itself.
props: label='Choose files', hint='or drop them here', accept, multiple=true, onFiles, className

### NumberField (kit/inputs)
import { NumberField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A number with a minus and a plus either side. The value is clamped to its range when you leave the field, never while you are typing.
props: label, hint, error, required, value, defaultValue=null, onChange, min=-Infinity, max=Infinity, step=1, suffix, className, disabled

### PasswordField (kit/inputs)
import { PasswordField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A password field with a show/hide toggle and a rough strength meter. Everything happens in the page; nothing is sent anywhere.
props: label="Password", hint, error, required, value, defaultValue='', onChange, meter=true, className, disabled

### RadioGroup (kit/inputs)
import { RadioGroup } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A group of real radio buttons under a legend: the arrow keys move and choose, Tab leaves the group, and a screen reader says “2 of 4”.
props: legend, options=[], value, defaultValue, onChange, name, row=false, className, disabled

### RangeField (kit/inputs)
import { RangeField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A slider: the native range input, with its value written beside the label and a text version (“240 ms”) for assistive technology.
props: label, hint, value, defaultValue=0, onChange, min=0, max=100, step=1, format=String, marks, className, disabled

### RichTextEditor (kit/inputs)
import { RichTextEditor } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A compact editor for bold, italic, underline and code, with sanitized HTML values and plain-text paste.
props: label='Rich text', value, defaultValue='', onChange, disabled=false, hint='Select text, then choose bold, italic, underline or code.', error, rows=6

### SearchField (kit/inputs)
import { SearchField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A search box with a clear button and, when you give it a count, a result count that is read out as it changes.
props: label='Search', hint, value, defaultValue='', onChange, count, noun="results", placeholder="Search…", className, disabled

### Segmented (kit/inputs)
import { Segmented } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A short row of exclusive choices drawn as one control, with an ink that glides to the chosen one. Radio buttons underneath.
props: label, options=[], value, defaultValue, onChange, name, className

### SelectField (kit/inputs)
import { SelectField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A native select, styled. Native on purpose: the platform’s own keyboard handling, its picker on a phone and its screen-reader behaviour come for free.
props: label, hint, error, required, options=[], value, defaultValue='', onChange, placeholder, className, disabled

### Switch (kit/inputs)
import { Switch } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
An on/off switch for a setting that takes effect at once. A button with role switch, so Space and Enter flip it and a screen reader says “on” or “off”.
props: label, checked, defaultChecked=false, onChange, disabled, showState=true, className, ...rest

### TagInput (kit/inputs)
import { TagInput } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Type a word, press Enter or a comma and it becomes a tag. Each tag has its own remove button, and adding or removing is announced.
props: label, hint, value, defaultValue=[], onChange, max=8, placeholder="Add a tag…", className, disabled

### TextArea (kit/inputs)
import { TextArea } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A multi-line field that counts. Going over the limit turns the count red and marks the field invalid; it never cuts off what you typed.
props: label, hint, error, required, maxLength, value, defaultValue='', onChange, rows=4, className, disabled, ...rest

### TextField (kit/inputs)
import { TextField } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A single-line text field with a label, hint and error, and an optional prefix and suffix inside the border for a currency, a unit or an @.
props: label, hint, error, required, prefix, suffix, className, disabled, type="text", ...input

### Breadcrumbs (kit/navigation)
import { Breadcrumbs } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Where you are, as a trail back up. The last item is the current page and is not a link.
props: items=[], label="Breadcrumb", className

### DropdownMenu (kit/navigation)
import { DropdownMenu } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A button that opens a menu of actions — not a navigation; use links for that. The ARIA menu-button pattern, with typeahead.
props: label, items=[], align="start", className

### OnThisPage (kit/navigation)
import { OnThisPage } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
An “on this page” list that follows the reader: the entry for the section nearest the top is marked, and pressing one scrolls there and moves focus to it.
props: items=[], label="On this page", className

### Pagination (kit/navigation)
import { Pagination } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Page buttons with the first, the last and the neighbours of the current one, “…” for what is skipped, and previous and next that stop at the ends.
props: page, defaultPage=1, pages=1, onChange, siblings=1, label='Pagination', className

### SideNav (kit/navigation)
import { SideNav } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A vertical navigation in groups that fold. A folded group is out of the tab order and the reading order, not only out of sight.
props: groups=[], current, label="Section navigation", className

### Stepper (kit/navigation)
import { Stepper } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
The steps of something with an order, and which one you are on. Done steps show a tick, the current one is aria-current, and each state is written out for a screen reader.
props: steps=[], current=0, label='Progress', className

### Tabs (kit/navigation)
import { Tabs } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Tabs that change a panel of content, as the ARIA pattern asks: one tab stop for the list, arrow keys move between tabs and show the panel at once.
props: tabs=[], value, defaultValue, onChange, label, className

### Toolbar (kit/navigation)
import { Toolbar } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A row of tool buttons that is one tab stop; the arrow keys move between the tools. A tool can be a toggle, with aria-pressed.
props: label, items=[], className

### Alert (kit/feedback)
import { Alert } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A message in the flow of the page. Information and success speak politely; warnings and errors interrupt. The tone is never carried by colour alone.
props: tone="info", title, children, onDismiss, className

### Banner (kit/feedback)
import { Banner } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A notice that runs the width of its container, for something about the whole page or site rather than one field. It may carry one action and may be dismissed.
props: title, children, action, dismissible=true, className

### EmptyState (kit/feedback)
import { EmptyState } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
What a list or a page says when there is nothing in it: why it is empty, and the one thing to do next. An empty state with no way forward is a dead end.
props: icon=Inbox, title, children, action, className

### Meter (kit/feedback)
import { Meter } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A gauge for a quantity inside a known range. The colour changes in the low and high zones and the zone is also written out for anyone who cannot see the colour.
props: label, value, min=0, max=100, low, high, cells=20, unit='', className

### ProgressBar (kit/feedback)
import { ProgressBar } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
How far along something is. With a value it announces its percentage; without one it is indeterminate and says it is working.
props: label, value, max=100, hideValue=false, className

### Skeleton (kit/feedback)
import { Skeleton } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
The shape of content that has not arrived yet, holding its space so nothing jumps when it does. Decorative: hidden from assistive technology.
props: width='100%', height='1rem', lines, className

### Spinner (kit/feedback)
import { Spinner } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A small “working on it” ring. It is a status message first — the label is announced — and a picture second. It stops turning for visitors who ask for less motion.
props: label="Loading", size="1.6rem", hideLabel=false, className

### StatusDot (kit/feedback)
import { StatusDot } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A coloured dot with its state spelled out beside it, so the colour is never the only signal. A live one can breathe.
props: state="idle", label=state word, pulse=false, className

### ToastProvider (kit/feedback)
import { ToastProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Brief messages in a corner that leave by themselves. Announced politely, never take focus, pause while the pointer or keyboard is on them, and can always be dismissed.
props: children, max=4, title, body, tone="info", duration=5000, max (provider)=4

### Avatar (kit/data)
import { Avatar } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A person, a team or a system as its initials in a circle or square. No photographs, on purpose: initials need no consent, load instantly and cannot be the wrong face.
props: name, size="2.4rem", shape='circle', tone, className, names, max (group)

### AvatarGroup (kit/data)
import { AvatarGroup } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Avatars stacked as one group, with a "+N" for the ones that do not fit.
props: names=[], max=4, size, className

### Badge (kit/data)
import { Badge } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A short label for the state or kind of a thing: New, Beta, Deprecated. The word carries the meaning; the tone only reinforces it.
props: children, tone="neutral", dot=false, className

### BarList (kit/data)
import { BarList } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Bars you can read as a list: each row has its label, a bar and the figure, so the values are text first and a picture second. The largest is picked out in red.
props: items=[], max=largest value, unit="", label, className

### Chip (kit/data)
import { Chip } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A compact pill that can be plain information, a toggle (give it onClick; selected says whether it is on) and/or removable (give it onRemove).
props: children, selected, onClick, onRemove, className

### CodeBlock (kit/data)
import { CodeBlock } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A block of code with an optional file name, light colouring and a copy button. The colour is a nicety: every token is also plain text, so copying gives exactly what you see.
props: code, language="js", filename, lines=false, className

### DataTable (kit/data)
import { DataTable } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A table you can sort and select from. A sortable column’s header is a button and the th carries aria-sort. It scrolls sideways inside a focusable region on a narrow screen.
props: caption, columns=[], rows=[], rowKey='id', selectable=false, onSelect, maxHeight, emptyText='No rows.', className

### DescriptionList (kit/data)
import { DescriptionList } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Terms and what they mean, or labels and their values — the right element for a fact sheet. A real dl, so a screen reader pairs each term with its detail.
props: items=[], stacked=false, className

### Sparkline (kit/data)
import { Sparkline } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A tiny line chart with no axes, for “which way is it going”. It is an image with a text description — range, first and last value — so the shape is never the only way to learn it.
props: data=[], label, width=180, height=44, unit='', className

### Stat (kit/data)
import { Stat } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
One number, large, with its label above and, if you have it, how it moved. The change is written as words for a screen reader; the arrow and colour are decoration.
props: label, value, unit, change, changeLabel, note, className

### Table (kit/data)
import { Table } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Semantic table parts with optional sortable headers and a selected-row action group.
props: caption='Table', children, label

import { TableHeader } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children

import { TableBody } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children

### TableFooter (kit/data)
import { TableFooter } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children

### TableRow (kit/data)
import { TableRow } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children, selected, ...props

### TableCell (kit/data)
import { TableCell } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children, align, ...props

### TableHeaderCell (kit/data)
import { TableHeaderCell } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children, sortDirection='none', onSort, scope='col', ...props

### TableSelectionToolbar (kit/data)
import { TableSelectionToolbar } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: count=0, onClear, children

### Timeline (kit/data)
import { Timeline } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Things in the order they happen, down a line. It is an ordered list, so the order is announced. This site’s own timeline is told in undated phases — pass words, not dates, unless you have them.
props: items=[], className

### Tree (kit/data)
import { Tree } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
An expandable tree — files, categories, an outline — following the ARIA tree-view pattern: one tab stop, arrow keys through what is visible.
props: nodes=[], label, onSelect, defaultOpen=[], className

### useTableSortable (kit/data)
import { useTableSortable } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ rows, sort, setSort, toggleSort(key) }.
returns: { rows, sort, setSort, toggleSort(key) }. sort = {key, direction}, with none / ascending / descending directions.

### useTableFilterState (kit/data)
import { useTableFilterState } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ filter, setFilter, setQuery, setColumnFilter, clearFilters }.
returns: { filter, setFilter, setQuery, setColumnFilter, clearFilters }. filter = {query, filters}.

### useTableFiltering (kit/data)
import { useTableFiltering } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
The filtered row array.
returns: The filtered row array. Text matching is case-insensitive. Array filter values match exact cell values.

### useTablePagination (kit/data)
import { useTablePagination } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ rows, page, pageCount, pageSize, total, setPage, nextPage, previousPage }.
returns: { rows, page, pageCount, pageSize, total, setPage, nextPage, previousPage }. page is zero-based and clamps as data shrinks.

### useTableSelectionState (kit/data)
import { useTableSelectionState } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ selectedKeys, setSelectedKeys, isSelected, toggle(key, selected?), clear }.
returns: { selectedKeys, setSelectedKeys, isSelected, toggle(key, selected?), clear }. Keys are stable row ids.

### useTableSelection (kit/data)
import { useTableSelection } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Selection state plus allSelected, someSelected, toggleAll and getRowProps.
returns: Selection state plus allSelected, someSelected, toggleAll and getRowProps. Bulk operations affect only the supplied rows.

### useTableRowExpansion (kit/data)
import { useTableRowExpansion } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ expandedKeys, setExpandedKeys, isExpanded, toggleExpanded, collapseAll }.
returns: { expandedKeys, setExpandedKeys, isExpanded, toggleExpanded, collapseAll }. No rows are expanded by default.

### useTableGroupedRows (kit/data)
import { useTableGroupedRows } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Array of { key, rows }, in first-seen group order.
returns: Array of { key, rows }, in first-seen group order. groupBy is a property key or function.

### useTableRowIndex (kit/data)
import { useTableRowIndex } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A function getIndex(key) returning the zero-based index, or -1 for missing keys.
returns: A function getIndex(key) returning the zero-based index, or -1 for missing keys.

### useTableRowStatus (kit/data)
import { useTableRowStatus } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A function getStatus(row) reading a status record or callback; unknown keys return undefined.
returns: A function getStatus(row) reading a status record or callback; unknown keys return undefined.

### useTableTreeState (kit/data)
import { useTableTreeState } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Expansion state using the same contract as useTableRowExpansion.
returns: Expansion state using the same contract as useTableRowExpansion.

### useTableTreeData (kit/data)
import { useTableTreeData } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Visible flattened entries: {row, id, depth, parentId, position, setSize, hasChildren, expanded}.
returns: Visible flattened entries: {row, id, depth, parentId, position, setSize, hasChildren, expanded}. Depth starts at 1. Keys must be unique.

### useTableColumnResize (kit/data)
import { useTableColumnResize } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ widths, widthOf, setWidth, getResizeHandleProps }.
returns: { widths, widthOf, setWidth, getResizeHandleProps }. Widths are pixels. Apply matching widths to table cells.

### useTableColumnSettings (kit/data)
import { useTableColumnSettings } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
{ columns, hidden, order, setOrder, toggleColumn, resetColumns }.
returns: { columns, hidden, order, setOrder, toggleColumn, resetColumns }. Removed keys are ignored; new columns append.

### useTableStickyColumns (kit/data)
import { useTableStickyColumns } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A function getStyle(key) returning a logical sticky offset for pinned start columns.
returns: A function getStyle(key) returning a logical sticky offset for pinned start columns. Width defaults to column.width or 160.

### ConfirmDialog (kit/overlays)
import { ConfirmDialog } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
“Are you sure?” done properly: the title says what will happen, the buttons say what they do, and for something that cannot be undone the safe choice has focus.
props: open, title, children, confirmLabel='Confirm', cancelLabel='Cancel', danger=false, onConfirm, onCancel

### Dialog (kit/overlays)
import { Dialog } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A modal dialog: it takes over the screen until it is dealt with. Focus moves in and is trapped, Escape and the backdrop close it, the page behind stops scrolling and focus returns to what opened it.
props: open, onClose, title, children, footer, width="32rem", side, dismissible=true, className

### Drawer (kit/overlays)
import { Drawer } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A dialog that slides in from an edge and runs the full height — for a filter panel or a record’s detail, where the page behind still gives context.
props: side="right", width="26rem", ...props, ...dialog

### HoverCard (kit/overlays)
import { HoverCard } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A preview card for a link: hover or focus the link and a little more about where it goes appears, and stays while the pointer is on it. It must only ever add.
props: title, body, children, delay=280, className

### Popover (kit/overlays)
import { Popover } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A panel that opens under a button and holds anything — text, a small form, a few links. It is not modal: focus stays where it is and Tab moves on into the panel.
props: label, title, children, align='start', placement='bottom', className

### Tooltip (kit/overlays)
import { Tooltip } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A short description that appears beside a control on hover or keyboard focus, after a beat so it does not flicker. It adds detail; it never replaces a label.
props: text, children, placement="top", delay=350, className

### AspectRatio (kit/content)
import { AspectRatio } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Reserves a box of a fixed shape and fills it with its child, so an image, a video or a chart has its room before it loads and nothing below it jumps.
props: ratio="16 / 9", children, className

### Callout (kit/content)
import { Callout } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A remark set apart from the text around it: a note, a tip, a warning. The kind is written out as a word as well as shown by colour and icon.
props: tone="note", title=tone word, children, className

### Card (kit/content)
import { Card } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A surface that groups related content, in four variants. The title is a heading whose level you choose, so the card fits the outline of the page it is on.
props: eyebrow, title, as="h3", children, footer, variant="raised", interactive=false, className

### Center (kit/content)
import { Center } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A capped column, centred in its parent — for a form, a card or a short passage. Fills the parent on a phone, stops at `max` on a desktop. New in this library.
props: as='div', max='36rem', align, className, children, style, ...rest

### Cluster (kit/content)
import { Cluster } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Children in a row that wraps when it runs out of room — buttons, tags, links.
props: children, gap=3, align='center', justify='flex-start', as='div', className

### Container (kit/content)
import { Container } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
The page width: centred, 1360 px max (gutters included), with a fluid 20–80 px gutter. size="text" narrows it to a 760 px reading column. New in this library — the same as the global `.container` class.
props: as='div', size='default', className, children, ...rest

### Disclosure (kit/content)
import { Disclosure } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
One section that opens and closes — a question and its answer, a “more detail”. The closed body is out of the tab order and the reading order, not only out of sight.
props: title, children, open, defaultOpen=false, onChange, as="h3", className

### Divider (kit/content)
import { Divider } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A line between things. Without a label it is a plain thematic break; with one it reads as a section break (“or”, “Later”) and is a separator, not a heading.
props: children, className

### Figure (kit/content)
import { Figure } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Something visual with a caption. The caption belongs to the figure, so a screen reader reads the two together.
props: children, caption, className

### Grid (kit/content)
import { Grid } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Children in as many equal columns as fit, none narrower than a minimum. There is no breakpoint to maintain: on a phone the minimum is wider than the screen, so you get one column.
props: children, min="15rem", gap=4, as='div', className

### Heading (kit/content)
import { Heading } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A heading in the serif voice. `level` is the HTML element (for the outline); `size` is how it looks, from the type scale — display, hero, h1–h4. New in this library.
props: level=2, size, as, className, children, ...rest

### Prose (kit/content)
import { Prose } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A reading column. Wrap plain HTML — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code, quotes — and it is typeset for reading: about 68 characters wide, generous leading, serif headings.
props: children, as="div", className

### Quote (kit/content)
import { Quote } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A pull quote with its source: a real blockquote inside a figure, the attribution as the caption. Only put words here that someone really said.
props: children, cite, className

### Resizable (kit/content)
import { Resizable } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Two resizable panels with a pointer- and keyboard-operated separator.
props: children, orientation='horizontal', value, defaultValue=50, onChange, min=10, max=90, label='Resizable panels'

### ResizablePanel (kit/content)
import { ResizablePanel } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children, label, side='start'

### ResizeHandle (kit/content)
import { ResizeHandle } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: label='Resize panels'

### Section (kit/content)
import { Section } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A page block's outer shell: the vertical rhythm between blocks (80–176 px, or 48–96 px with size="sm"). New in this library — the same as the global `.section` class.
props: as='section', size='md', className, children, ...rest

### Stack (kit/content)
import { Stack } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Children in a column with an even gap taken from the spacing tokens.
props: children, gap=4, as="div", className

### Text (kit/content)
import { Text } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Text in one of the three voices: body, lead, small, caption, or the mono uppercase label. Tone is an opacity of white (strong, default, dim) or red. New in this library.
props: variant='body', tone='default', measure=false, as, className, children, ...rest

### VisuallyHidden (kit/content)
import { VisuallyHidden } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Text for assistive technology that is not drawn: the “Close” on an icon-only button, the “(current page)” after a link. It stays in the reading order and out of the layout.
props: children, as="span"

### useResizable (kit/content)
import { useResizable } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Percentage split state and separator bindings for pointer and keyboard resizing.
returns: { size, setSize(next), handleProps }. size is a clamped percentage. handleProps contains separator ARIA, pointer capture and keyboard handlers.

### Chat (kit/chat)
import { Chat } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Composable conversation regions, transcript items and a message composer with asynchronous send handling.
props: label='Conversation', children

### ChatLayout (kit/chat)
import { ChatLayout } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
A bounded conversation viewport with a separate composer slot.
props: children, composer, label='Conversation', maxHeight='32rem'

### ChatLayoutScrollButton (kit/chat)
import { ChatLayoutScrollButton } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
Scroll the supplied message-list ref to its latest message without moving focus.
props: targetRef, children='Latest message'

### ChatMessageList (kit/chat)
import { ChatMessageList } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
An ordered transcript. Announcements are opt-in to avoid rereading history.
props: children, label='Messages', announce=false, ref

### ChatMessage (kit/chat)
import { ChatMessage } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';
One transcript item; author names are visible, and role is never only a colour.
props: author, children, metadata, role='assistant'

import { ChatMessageBubble } from 'hanoryx-components/kit';

props: children

## Foreground toolkit

### Accordion
import { Accordion } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A disclosure list with real height animation: index, title and a mono code per row; the code scrambles on hover or focus, the plus turns, the body opens with eased height.
props: items, single=true, defaultOpen=null, numbered=true, className

### ArrowLink
import { ArrowLink } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
An inline call to action: an underline draws left→right on hover and the arrow glides out of its corner. Becomes a router Link (`to`), an external link (`href`) or a button.
props: to, href, children, className, tone='default', ...rest

### CompareSlider
import { CompareSlider } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
Before / after comparison. Drag the handle (mouse, touch, pen), press the track to glide there, or use ← → Home End on the handle.
props: before, after, beforeLabel='Before', afterLabel='After', initial=50, value, onChange, label='Comparison', className, ...rest

### DragRail
import { DragRail } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A horizontal rail of cards. Touch scrolls natively with snap; with a mouse you can grab and fling it. The rail is a named, keyboard-scrollable region.
props: children, label='Scrollable list', className

### GlideTabs
import { GlideTabs } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A segmented control / tab list whose selection ink glides between tabs. Full tablist keyboard model; pass `panels={false}` when it only changes a nearby demo (then it is announced as a radio group).
props: tabs, value, onChange, label, idPrefix='tabs', variant='pill', panels=true, className, ...rest

### Glyph
import { Glyph } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A drawn SVG glyph from a set of 27 line glyphs (orbit, layers, flow, grid, shield, chart, terminal…) that draws itself in. `play` replays the draw-in; hover any ancestor with `.glyph-host` to redraw.
props: name, size=40, className, playKey=0, title, ...rest

### HoverIndex
import { HoverIndex } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A typographic index: big rows that a floating preview card follows the cursor across. On touch or keyboard every row shows its own detail line, so nothing hides behind hover.
props: items, className

### KeyCap
import { KeyCap } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A visible keyboard key. `pressed` gives it the depressed, lit state.
props: children, pressed=false, className, ...rest

### Odometer
import { Odometer } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A number that rolls into place, each digit on its own wheel with a stagger. Starts at 0 and settles when it scrolls into view.
props: value, decimals=0, prefix='', suffix='', className

### ProgressRing
import { ProgressRing } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A ring gauge. `value` is 0..1; the stroke eases to it with a CSS transition, so ticking a checkbox sweeps the ring instead of jumping.
props: value=0, size=96, stroke=3, label, children, className, ...rest

### ProximityText
import { ProximityText } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
Text that reacts to the pointer: each unit lifts, swells and warms toward red as the cursor comes near. Touch and reduced motion get plain text.
props: text, as='span', by='word', radius=220, className, unitClassName, ...rest

### RichText
import { RichText } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
Inline markup for copy that lives in plain data files: `**bold**`, `` `code` `` and `{{defined term}}`. A term with an entry in `terms` becomes a focusable word whose definition appears on hover or focus.
props: text, terms, highlight

### ScrambleText
import { ScrambleText } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
Text that decodes from noise into its final form, left to right. Shows the final text at once under reduced motion.
props: text, as='span', trigger=0, auto=false, duration=720, className, ...rest

### ScrollRail
import { ScrollRail } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A quiet progress rail for long pages: one tick per section; the current one stretches and lights; hover or focus names it; click glides there.
props: sections

### ScrollWords
import { ScrollWords } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A passage that lights up word by word as you scroll through it — reading pace becomes scroll pace. One ScrollTrigger writes a single `--p` onto the element.
props: text, as='p', className, startAt=0.86, endAt=0.42, ...rest

### SpotlightCard
import { SpotlightCard } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A card whose 1 px border and surface are lit by the pointer: a radial light travels the border while a faint glow pools under the cursor. Becomes a link with `to` or `href`.
props: to, href, tone='red', className, innerClassName, children, ...rest

### TiltSurface
import { TiltSurface } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A surface that leans toward the pointer, with a specular highlight that follows it. Driven by CSS variables (no React state); touch and reduced motion get a still surface. Children may use `data-depth="n"` to drift against the tilt.
props: as='div', tilt=7, glare=true, className, style, children, ...rest

### VelocityMarquee
import { VelocityMarquee } from 'hanoryx-components/fx';
A marquee that reads the page’s scroll. It drifts on its own, speeds up and leans with scroll velocity, and slows under the pointer. Reduced motion shows the first set, still.
props: items, speed=46, direction=1, className, itemClassName

## Site UI

### Button
import { Button } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
The primary interactive control. It becomes a router `Link` with `to`, an `<a>` with `href` (external links open safely in a new tab) and a `<button>` otherwise. Magnetic pull toward the pointer by default.
props: to, href, variant='primary', size='md', icon, magnetic=true, className, children, ...rest

### CatalogError
import { CatalogError } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
The "could not load" state for catalogue-backed controls, with a retry action. Announced as an alert.
props: retry, subject='page list'

### DataPanel
import { DataPanel } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
The glass data panel — the base surface for cards and modules: optional corner brackets, a mono code/label strip, a hover scan-line, and an optional link.
props: code, label, brackets=true, interactive=false, tone='default', to, href, className, children, ...rest

### GlitchLine
import { GlitchLine } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
A thin animated divider — a hairline with a slow travelling highlight and a rare red glitch tick. Decorative; frozen under reduced motion.
props: tone='default', className, ...rest

### Pill
import { Pill } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
A small mono tag or status chip. `dot` adds a live indicator; `icon` a leading icon.
props: children, variant='default', dot=false, icon, className, ...rest

### SectionHeader
import { SectionHeader } from 'hanoryx-components/ui';
Eyebrow + serif title + optional intro, with a staged reveal. The head of nearly every block.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, code, as='h2', size='h2', align='left', variant='up', reveal=true, className, children

## Page

### HeroTitle (page/template)
import { HeroTitle } from 'hanoryx-components/page';
The hero headline: each word rises out of a clipped line (staggered), then the words react to the pointer.

### NotFound (page/template)
import { NotFound } from 'hanoryx-components/page';

import { PageBlock } from 'hanoryx-components/page';
The block dispatcher: draws one block from `{ type, … }`. Built-in types render directly; the data-first kinds are lazy chunks.

import { PageTemplate } from 'hanoryx-components/page';
Renders a whole page from a data object: a scene-backed hero, then each block in order, plus a scroll rail for blocks that declare `anchor` + `railLabel`. Sets the document title and wraps the page in a transition.
props: data

### TemplatePage (page/template)
import { TemplatePage } from 'hanoryx-components/page';
A route element for a data-driven page: loads the page by key through the registered `loadPage` source (its own code-split chunk), suspends on the route fallback, and shows the 404 when there is no data.

## Shell

### AudioSignalButton (shell/audio)
import { AudioSignalButton } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Compact audio control for the navbar: a live frequency visualizer + state readout.
props: className

### AudioVisualizer (shell/audio)
import { AudioVisualizer } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Canvas frequency visualizer. Reacts to real audio when playing; idles subtly when paused. Size via CSS.
props: bars=16, className

### HanoryxCursor (shell/cursor)
import { HanoryxCursor } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The designed precision cursor: a tight core dot tracks the pointer while a reticle follows with a little lag, and grows over elements marked `data-cursor`. Fine pointers only; off under reduced motion.

### BootSequence (shell/effects)
import { BootSequence } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The cinematic intro: brand and a START control, a HUD calibration with terminal lines, then the lift. Starts the ambient track inside the click when one is configured.
props: onComplete, onExited

### MagneticButton (shell/effects)
import { MagneticButton } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Wraps an interactive element with a subtle magnetic pull toward the pointer. Polymorphic via `as` (a `<button>` by default). Off for coarse pointers and reduced motion.
props: as='button', strength=0.35, radius=90, className, children, ...rest

### NoiseOverlay (shell/effects)
import { NoiseOverlay } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Fixed, full-viewport film-grain veil built from an inline SVG turbulence filter (no external asset). Pointer-events none, very low opacity.
props: className

### PerfDebug (shell/effects)
import { PerfDebug } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Development-only performance HUD. Shows live FPS, active rAF subscribers (≈ running scenes/loops), and the current quality tier. Reads values on a 500ms interval and writes them straight to the DOM — no per-frame React state.

### ScanlineOverlay (shell/effects)
import { ScanlineOverlay } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Fixed, full-viewport CRT scanline veil. Extremely subtle, static and pointer-events none.
props: className

### SynthesisCanvas (shell/experience)
import { SynthesisCanvas } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
SynthesisCanvas — the heavy, procedural half of the cinematic. A single canvas drives every particle/ring/grid layer for all eleven phases.
props: accent='#ff3333', quality='high', initialTime=0, className

### SystemSynthesisOverlay (shell/experience)
import { SystemSynthesisOverlay } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
SystemSynthesisOverlay — the full-screen takeover. NOT a page, NOT a player.
props: onClose

### Footer (shell/layout)
import { Footer } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The site footer — a directory of the whole site, not a second navigation bar: six columns of grouped links, live section counts, the status and the legal row. Collapses to disclosures on a phone.

### PageTransition (shell/layout)
import { PageTransition } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Wraps a page so routes fade and slide between each other, at a dim level — never fully dark. Transform and opacity only. Pairs with `AnimatePresence mode="wait"` around the routes.
props: children, className

### RouteAnnouncer (shell/layout)
import { RouteAnnouncer } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Tells assistive technology that a new page has opened: waits for the title to settle, says it in a polite status region, and moves focus to `main`.

### RouteFallback (shell/layout)
import { RouteFallback } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The loading state while a route chunk streams in: a pulsing telemetry line, quiet and short-lived. Use as the `Suspense` fallback of your routes.

### SiteShell (shell/layout)
import { SiteShell } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The frame around every page: skip link, navbar, mobile menu, footer, search, shortcuts, cursor, film-grain and scanline veils, route transitions and the boot intro. Wrap the routes in it once.
props: children

### AdvancedNavbar (shell/navigation)
import { AdvancedNavbar } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The primary navigation: a hover-intent controller and a wide full-screen-width menu (categories on the left, pages across the right). Reads its groups from the navigation config.
props: menuOpen, onToggleMenu, revealed=true

### MegaPanel (shell/navigation)
import { MegaPanel } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The presence wrapper: the sheet stays mounted while a group is open, so moving from one group to the next swaps its contents instead of replaying the drop.
props: group, ...rest

### MobileNav (shell/navigation)
import { MobileNav } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The full-screen phone menu: expandable route groups, the audio control and the status. Opened by the navbar burger.
props: open, onClose

### NodeMap (shell/navigation)
import { NodeMap } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The site's orbit diagram, kept as a small aside in the wide menu: a drawn ring with one node per page of the open category, a selector arc that swings to the page being pointed at, and the group's code at the core.
props: count, hot, code

### ScrollProgress (shell/navigation)
import { ScrollProgress } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
A hairline at the top edge that fills with page scroll progress.

### CommandPalette (shell/search)
import { CommandPalette } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Command palette and site search: a portal overlay anchored near the top, section chips, highlighted body-text excerpts and full keyboard handling. Opens with Ctrl/⌘ K or `/`.
props: enabled=true

### BlueprintLayer (shell/shortcuts)
import { BlueprintLayer } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Blueprint mode. `html.blueprint` outlines every marked part of the page (see styles/fx.css);
props: active

### GlobalKeys (shell/shortcuts)
import { GlobalKeys } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
Site-wide single-key shortcuts that belong to no one page: `?` opens the shortcuts panel and `B` switches blueprint mode. Switchable off for WCAG 2.1.4 (`html[data-keys="off"]`).
props: enabled

### ShortcutsOverlay (shell/shortcuts)
import { ShortcutsOverlay } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The "?" panel: a short list of the keys that do something here.
props: open, onClose

### TransitionOverlay (shell/transitions)
import { TransitionOverlay } from 'hanoryx-components/shell';
The route "current": navigating does not cover the screen — a thin red line travels the viewport with the destination written at its end. Skipped under reduced motion.

## Reveal & kinetic type

### Reveal
import { Reveal } from 'hanoryx-components/reveal';
Reveal — animate a single element into view with a named profile. <Reveal profile="slideLeft" as="p">…</Reveal> Honours reduced motion (static).
props: profile='fadeUp', as='div', delay=0, amount=0.3, once=true, className, children, style, ...rest

### RevealGroup
import { RevealGroup } from 'hanoryx-components/reveal';
RevealGroup — staggers its children, each entering with the same per-item profile. Like Reveal, this does not re-render on scroll: the container and item variants are stable so the staggered entrance plays once.
props: profile='fadeUp', as='div', itemAs='div', stagger=0.08, delayChildren=0.05, amount=0.2, once=true, className, itemClassName, children, ...rest

### KineticText
import { KineticText } from 'hanoryx-components/reveal';
Split-text reveal. Each character (or word) rises out of a clipped line with a staggered cadence — the signature "kinetic" headline motion. Pure CSS spans, no paid SplitText plugin.
props: text='', as='span', by='char', stagger, duration=0.9, immediate=false, delay=0, start='top 88%', className, ...rest

## Scenes

### SceneCanvas (scenes/host)
import { SceneCanvas } from 'hanoryx-components/scenes';
Renders a single registered scene onto a canvas. - the scene library is loaded on demand (code-split) via ensureScenes() - each scene registers with the SCENE BUDGET: only the few most-visible scenes animate at once;
props: scene, sceneData, cost='medium', density=1, accent='#ff3333', still=false, className

### SectionScene (scenes/host)
import { SectionScene } from 'hanoryx-components/scenes';
Wraps a section with its own animated scene behind the content. This is how the site avoids one global background: every block declares its own `scene` + `intensity`. The canvas paints behind; content sits above with a stacking context.
props: scene, sceneData, intensity='medium', accent='#ff3333', density=1, fade=true, as='section', className, contentClassName, children, ...rest

### architectural-grid (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="architectural-grid" />
Technical blueprint surface: major + minor grid, measuring ticks, corner crosshair marks and dimension dashes, with a slow vertical drift and a single red crosshair node tracing the grid like a CAD cursor.

### blackout-silhouette (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="blackout-silhouette" />
A hidden silhouette under redaction. Faint hatched black regions conceal an abstract geometric form; a vertical scan line sweeps across and briefly reveals the red edge contours where it passes, then re-conceals.

### circuit-trace (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="circuit-trace" />
PCB-like traces with pulses travelling along right-angle paths.

### command-terminal (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="command-terminal" />
A terminal readout — monospace log lines scan in sequence, a caret blinks on the active line, and a faint highlight bar sweeps down the column. One red WARN line. Static strings, low-alpha white; mysterious technical mood.

### concentric-gate (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="concentric-gate" />
Concentric gate rings that draw open in staggered arcs — portal / hero core.

### data-rain (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="data-rain" />
Restrained vertical data columns — measured, not a Matrix spam wall.

### flow-field (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="flow-field" />
Optimized particle flow field with pointer displacement. Trails via a low alpha fill over the (near-black) section. Density scales with quality.

### glass-prism (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="glass-prism" />
Angular translucent glass panels — rotated quads with faint white gradient fills and crisp edges, drifting and parallaxing as layered glass.

### glyph-field (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="glyph-field" />
A sparse grid of abstract glyphs — small geometric marks (+, circles, brackets, short bars) that breathe in and out and occasionally swap form, like an unknown symbol language slowly writing itself.

### heatmap-grid (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="heatmap-grid" />
Operational heatmap: a grid of cells whose intensity pulses as a sum of slow sine waves over position + time. Bright cells take a faint red tint, dim cells stay barely-there white.

### hex-lattice (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="hex-lattice" />
Hexagon lattice with a travelling scan that lights nodes as it passes.

### isometric-module (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="isometric-module" />
Isometric cubes drifting through depth — faint white volumes that bob and parallax. One cube is edge-lit in the accent red. 2:1 iso projection.

### liquid-metal (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="liquid-metal" />
Soft elliptical blobs drifting and breathing — a calm metallic sheen. Large radial-gradient ellipses overlap with very low alpha; no hard edges.

### magnetic-particles (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="magnetic-particles" />
Particles drifting in a slow ambient field, magnetically drawn toward the pointer when active — pulled in, brightened, then easing back when released.

### network-constellation (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="network-constellation" />
Connected graph with light physics drift — a constellation / service map. Connections use a spatial cap (nearest by distance) to stay cheap.

### orbital-node (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="orbital-node" />
Concentric orbits of nodes circling a core — multi-role / system map feel.

### polar-radar (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="polar-radar" />
Rotating radar sweep with concentric rings and bearing ticks.

### architecture-layer (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="architecture-layer" />
ARCHITECTURE LAYER — a system blueprint of 4-5 stacked slab layers drawn in a slight isometric skew, joined by vertical connectors; a red data pulse rises through the stack, briefly lighting each layer it passes.

### audio-signal-wall (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="audio-signal-wall" />
AUDIO SIGNAL WALL — full-width spectrum visualizer. Reacts to live audio via the shared audio bridge; falls back to a procedural idle signal when nothing is playing. A faint baseline grid + a mirrored reflection give it depth.

### build-pipeline (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="build-pipeline" />
BUILD PIPELINE — 5 stage gates chained left to right; a build token advances gate by gate, each cleared stage fills with a check-tick pulse, and an occasional parallel branch forks below. A CI/build shape language.

### client-portal-gate (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="client-portal-gate" />
CLIENT PORTAL GATE — two concentric iris rings of arc blades that rhythmically open (gaps widen) then re-seal like an aperture, a rotating radial scan beam sweeps the field, and a locked diamond core glyph blinks red on each seal.

### commerce-pipeline (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="commerce-pipeline" />
COMMERCE PIPELINE — horizontal lanes carry small order tokens left to right through vertical stage gates; a soft scan band sweeps across, and the rare flagged order glows red. A logistics/order-flow shape language, no grid.

### compass-vector (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="compass-vector" />
Canvas scene "compass-vector".

### contact-transmission (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="contact-transmission" />
CONTACT TRANSMISSION — concentric ping rings emit outward from a source point at timed intervals over faint carrier waves, with a few drifting signal motes.

### dashboard-tiles (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="dashboard-tiles" />
DASHBOARD TILES — a bento grid of varied-size panels, each running a tiny live widget (sparkline, mini bars, blinking dot, gauge arc, ticker), while a single red focus highlight glides from tile to tile like a roving control cursor.

### data-interface-wave (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="data-interface-wave" />
Canvas scene "data-interface-wave".

### data-stream-ribbons (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="data-stream-ribbons" />
DATA STREAM RIBBONS — several bright thin straight diagonal ribbons of flowing dashes carrying data in transit; bright packet glints ride each stream over a faint baseline grid. Straight diagonal dash flow, not braided curves.

### dependency-graph (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="dependency-graph" />
DEPENDENCY GRAPH — modules in left-to-right layers wired by directed edges (a build DAG); a build wave sweeps left to right, compiling each layer: edges fill and node cores ignite in order.

### error-signal-lost (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="error-signal-lost" />
ERROR / SIGNAL LOST (404) — a near-flat heartbeat trace that twitches, glitches and drops out into a dead flatline, intermittent horizontal static bands tear across the screen, and a faint radar sweep hunts the void but finds nothing.

### glyph-compiler (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="glyph-compiler" />
GLYPH COMPILER — scattered mono glyphs drift in space, then snap into neat left-aligned rows (compiling), hold as clean labels, then dissolve back to scatter. A red caret/scan rides the row that is currently resolving.

### heatmap-control (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="heatmap-control" />
HEATMAP CONTROL — a dashboard heatmap: a tight grid of cells lit by several smooth gaussian "activity" blobs drifting across the field; warmth fades cell to cell, and only the hottest cells latch a sparse red accent outline.

### hex-tunnel (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="hex-tunnel" />
HEX TUNNEL — concentric hexagons surge outward from a vanishing point toward the viewer, each ring slightly counter-rotated and fading with depth; one pulsing red ring rides the loop. Built ring-by-ring (not a flat lattice).

### home-core (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="home-core" />
HOME CORE — the cinematic hero composite: a faint scrolling grid, a central arc/gate system that breathes, and a sparse particle field drifting over it. Pointer nudges the core. The most layered scene in the library.

### interface-lab-shape (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="interface-lab-shape" />
INTERFACE LAB SHAPE — abstract UI "component" specimens (toolbars, cards, toggles) as rounded-rect outlines with corner brackets that snap to a grid and periodically resize / rearrange between layout takes.

### isometric-infra (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="isometric-infra" />
ISOMETRIC INFRA — a blueprint isometric module field where lit modules sweep across in travelling diagonal clusters; a few of the brightest modules extrude tall vertical "data columns" that pulse upward. Faint base lattice, sparse red.

### liquid-glass-operational (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="liquid-glass-operational" />
LIQUID GLASS OPERATIONAL — large rounded translucent glass capsules drifting and overlapping, with soft white rim highlights, a faint inner sheen and thin refraction lines bending through each body. Calm, premium, operational.

Canvas scene "magnetic-vector".

<SceneCanvas scene="motion-curve-field" />
Canvas scene "motion-curve-field".

### musebase-coordination (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="musebase-coordination" />
MUSEBASE COORDINATION — a central core with four module clusters (scheduling, communication, records, payment) orbiting on a wide ring;

### node-compression (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="node-compression" />
NODE COMPRESSION — scattered nodes breathe inward to a centred ordered ring lattice then disperse; connector lines thicken and brighten at peak compression, red core.

### orbital-command (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="orbital-command" />
ORBITAL COMMAND — a single command ring of evenly spaced route nodes with short packets routing along inter-node chords and a pulsing accent core.

### permission-orbit (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="permission-orbit" />
PERMISSION ORBIT — role/permission nodes orbit a central lock core on three concentric rings, each rotating at its own rate; a thin radial connector to a node blinks red as the node sweeps past the vertical "grant" axis.

### polar-status (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="polar-status" />
POLAR STATUS — a single instrument dial: a radial tick gauge with a red arc that fills to a slowly drifting setpoint, satellite readout dots on an outer ring, and a thin sweeping indicator needle. Pointer nudges the setpoint.

### privacy-quiet-grid (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="privacy-quiet-grid" />
PRIVACY QUIET GRID — a calm legal-page grid: a slow faint line grid, an occasional soft scan band drifting through long pauses, and a few slow-drifting tick marks that tick faintly red at their dwell points.

### radar-cutaway (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="radar-cutaway" />
RADAR CUTAWAY — a quarter radar anchored to the bottom-left corner: range rings and bearing spokes clipped to a 90deg wedge, a sweeping arm that paints contacts red as it crosses them, with blips that bloom then fade behind the sweep.

### radial-audio-core (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="radial-audio-core" />
RADIAL AUDIO CORE — a centred radial spectrum. drawRadialBars fans out from a white core ring, driven by live audio.bands (idle procedural when silent). Loud beats spawn outward-expanding pulse rings;

### redacted-timeline-branch (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="redacted-timeline-branch" />
REDACTED TIMELINE BRANCH — a horizontal timeline spine with ticking time markers;

### research-blackout (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="research-blackout" />
RESEARCH BLACKOUT — rows of redacted/blacked-out bars over a dark field; a slow horizontal scan band sweeps across, momentarily exposing bars it passes, while rare cells flicker a partial red reveal. Mostly dark and ominous.

### scheduling-grid (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="scheduling-grid" />
SCHEDULING GRID — an abstract week planner: vertical lanes split by horizontal time rows, booking blocks of varying length fade in and out across the lanes, and a vertical "now" line sweeps left->right lighting blocks it crosses;

### secure-boundary (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="secure-boundary" />
SECURE BOUNDARY — a central protected zone ringed by a slowly rotating dashed perimeter with a single accent gate aperture; access nodes drift in from outside and either thread the gate into the core or deflect off the wall.

### signal-spectrum-field (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="signal-spectrum-field" />
Canvas scene "signal-spectrum-field".

### split-prism (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="split-prism" />
SPLIT PRISM — the field sliced by several parallel diagonal seams whose offsets drift; each pane carries a faint distinct texture (fine lines / dot lattice / blank), and a bright edge highlight runs along the seams.

### status-pulse-grid (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="status-pulse-grid" />
STATUS PULSE GRID — a system monitor matrix of square status tiles; diagonal activation waves sweep across, lighting tiles as they pass; most tiles sit dim, a sparse few latch to a red "alert" state. Pointer drags a local hot zone.

### tooling-console (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="tooling-console" />
TOOLING CONSOLE — a faint terminal: a prompt with a blinking caret, left-aligned mono glyph lines that type in char-by-char, and a command-palette box that slides in from the right then retracts, its top entry highlighted red.

### topology-pulse (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="topology-pulse" />
TOPOLOGY PULSE — horizontal topographic contour lines crossed by a bright radial pulse ring that expands from a slowly drifting emitter, lifting nearby contours.

### transaction-wave (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="transaction-wave" />
TRANSACTION WAVE — a commerce throughput ticker: transaction spikes erupt upward from a baseline at varying heights, a slow cumulative line climbs across, faint value gridlines behind. Markets/throughput shape language, no full grid.

### trigger-action-pulse (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="trigger-action-pulse" />
TRIGGER ACTION PULSE — trigger nodes on the left fire pulses along rule-lines (some branching) to action nodes on the right, which flash red on arrival; a cause-and-effect automation rhythm.

### unknown-silhouette (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="unknown-silhouette" />
UNKNOWN SILHOUETTE — a large blacked-out irregular polygon mass sits centre, breathing slowly with a faint rim and rare red edge leaks; a sparse corner-bracket scanning frame and a column of redacted readout ticks surround it.

### workflow-river (scenes/presets)
<SceneCanvas scene="workflow-river" />
WORKFLOW RIVER — many near-parallel curved streamlines drifting left-to-right like a braided river, with directional flow particles riding the exact curves at varying per-lane speed; sparse red marks the leading current.

### redaction-matrix (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="redaction-matrix" />
A field of black metadata bars with a scan line that briefly "decrypts" the bars it passes over — classified / redacted mood.

### signal-wave (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="signal-wave" />
Oscilloscope signal — a centered horizontal waveform of summed sines that scrolls continuously over a faint grid, flanked by two fainter secondary waves, with a red leading dot tracing the main trace.

### spline-ribbon (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="spline-ribbon" />
Flowing bezier ribbons drifting across the field — a data stream.

### timeline-pulse (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="timeline-pulse" />
A horizontal baseline through evenly spaced nodes. A bright red pulse sweeps left-to-right repeatedly, igniting each node as it passes. Faint vertical ticks drop beneath every node; the line itself is faint white.

### topographic-lines (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="topographic-lines" />
Flowing contour / topology lines that breathe like terrain.

### vector-compass (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="vector-compass" />
Vector direction field: a fixed grid of short arrow segments whose angles track flowAngle(x,y,t) and rotate smoothly, like compasses leaning into an invisible current. Faint white, sparse red. Cells are static;

### voronoi-cell (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="voronoi-cell" />
Computational cell field — jittered sites drift and connect to their 2–3 nearest neighbours, approximating Voronoi cell walls without the cost of a full diagram. A few accent sites pulse red.

### wave-interference (scenes/base)
<SceneCanvas scene="wave-interference" />
Layered sine-wave interference field — calm, signal-like horizontal bands.

## Signatures

### AccordionList
import { AccordionList } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
A titled list of disclosures (eased height, a scrambling code on hover, a plus that turns). Plain-text bodies are wrapped in a paragraph here so page data stays plain JSON.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, items, defaultOpen, single=true, variant='left', note, marker='list.accordion'

### ArchitectureExplorer
import { ArchitectureExplorer } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The four layers of this website as a row. Pick one to see what feeds it, what it produces and where the code lives (shown as plain paths).
props: eyebrow, title, intro, layers, note

### AreasExplorer
import { AreasExplorer } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Areas of work as a row of strips. The strip you point at (or focus, or tap) opens while its neighbours fold to a vertical label; on a phone the same set becomes a stack that opens downward.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, areas, note

### ArticleArt
import { ArticleArt } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The hero object of a guide: its drawing, large. It draws itself in once, and again whenever you point at it.
props: art, caption

### ArticleArtShape
import { ArticleArtShape } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
ArticleArtShape is an extracted page composition.
props: art, className

### AuditLog
import { AuditLog } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
An audit trail is judged by the questions it can answer. Choose which fields a log records; the questions people actually ask light up as answerable — or go dark, with the missing field named.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, fields=[], questions=[], note

### BasketAside
import { BasketAside } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Hero object for the customer-product page: six abstract tiles. Tap one to "add" it — it lifts, takes a tick, and the basket count rolls up. A tiny taste of the experience; the tiles are shapes, not products.
props: caption

### BoundaryMembrane
import { BoundaryMembrane } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The line between inside and outside. Twelve records sit behind a membrane; choose a role and the records that role may reach cross to the outside while the rest stay where they are.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, records, roles, note

### BoundaryReview
import { BoundaryReview } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
A review aid. Work through the questions for a system you are building; the ring and each group's bar fill as you answer. It does not assess any real system and stores nothing — ticks live in this page only.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, groups, note

### BrandBoard
import { BrandBoard } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The brand as the site actually uses it, in five panels: the mark and the room it needs, the colours (click to copy;
props: eyebrow, title, intro, mark, colours=[], faces=[], curves=[], voice=[]

### BugCatcher
import { BugCatcher } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Which kind of check catches which kind of problem? Switch checks on and off and watch what slips through. The grid is a judgement, not a measurement: it records what experience says each kind of check is good at.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, checks=[], problems=[], note

### CapabilityMatrix
import { CapabilityMatrix } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
What an operational system is usually made of, and which kind of system tends to need what. A reference, drawn as a grid: a judgement from experience, not a statement about any one project.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, areas=[], capabilities=[], note

### CaseDeck
import { CaseDeck } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Hero object for the Work page: the four case studies as a deck of files. At rest they sit stacked with a slight fan; hover the deck and the cards spread out one by one, and the card under the pointer lifts. Each is a real link.

### ChronologyScrubber
import { ChronologyScrubber } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The company chronology as something you move through. Drag the playhead (or press ← → Home End on it, or click a stop or a row) and the stage beneath glides from phase to phase; "Play through" walks the whole sequence.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, phases, note

### ChronologyStrip
import { ChronologyStrip } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
A compact, horizontal preview of the company chronology. A line draws as the strip scrolls into view and the phase nodes light in turn (--p, one ScrollTrigger, CSS derives each node's state); the last node is the live one.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, phases, linkLabel

### ClaimsLedger
import { ClaimsLedger } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
The trust centre's ledger: three columns — what the site does, what it does not claim, and what is still open — each row a disclosure that says how you can check it for yourself and links to the page that proves it.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, columns=[]

### ClauseFinder
import { ClauseFinder } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Plain-language clauses you can filter. Type to narrow, pick a topic, open a clause. The one-line gist sits under every title so the list can be read without opening anything.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, topics, clauses, note

A bench for the site's own small components. Pick a specimen, change its props, and see the real component respond — then hover it, tab to it, press it.

### ContrastChecker
import { ContrastChecker } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Two colours in, the WCAG contrast ratio out, with a verdict for each kind of thing that has to be read, and the nearest passing colour when it falls short. Runs entirely in the page; nothing is sent anywhere.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, note, start={ fg: '#9a9ea6', bg: '#0a0b0d' }

### CoordinationLab
import { CoordinationLab } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
Musebase foreground: three interactions about one idea. 1. PLACE — drag blocks across lanes and time; overlapping blocks flag, and "Resolve" glides them apart. 2. COMPARE — the same set scattered vs coordinated, with a slider. 3.

### DotField

### EasingStudio

### GateWalk
import { GateWalk } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
"Each stage gates the next." Walk a system from intent to release: the runner can only pass a gate once everything that gate asks has been ticked. Passing a gate glides the runner to the next stage; the last one releases.

### IdempotencyDemo
import { IdempotencyDemo } from 'hanoryx-components/signatures';
A payment request whose answer gets lost on the way back. With no idempotency key the client retries and the customer is charged twice; with one, the server recognises the retry and replays its first answer.
props: eyebrow, title, intro, amount=20, note

### IdentityCard

A one-page runbook template, laid out as a card. Read it here, copy it, or download it as Markdown and fill it in for a real service.
props: tag, title, lede, sections=[], onward

### PairMatrix
import { PairMatrix } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Check a whole palette at once. Paste colours, and every text-on-background pairing is graded in a grid, so the ones that never work are visible before anyone designs with them.
props: tag, title, lede, start='#0a0b0d, #f5f5f2, #d92b2b, #9a9ea6, #2b6cb0', onward

### ParcelTrack
import { ParcelTrack } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A tracking line for a report: four stations, a parcel that travels to the one you choose, and who handles that stage. No timings are promised or implied — only the order things happen in.
props: tag, title, lede, stages=[], onward

### PipelineMaker
import { PipelineMaker } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Assemble a checks pipeline: choose the checks, put them in order, and a workflow file comes out, with the same sequence as a local script. The commands are placeholders for your project's own.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### PreMortem
import { PreMortem } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
The pre-mortem: imagine a year has passed and the decision turned out badly. What went wrong? Write the reasons, how likely each is, and what you would do about it now. The riskiest come out first, as a table.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### PrefsPanel
import { PrefsPanel } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Display preferences for this view — text size, line spacing, contrast, a calm mode and the single-key shortcuts — that take effect at once and last only until the page is reloaded.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### PrepSheet
import { PrepSheet } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
The "before a first conversation" sheet: what is worth having to hand. A take-away list, ticked as you go and copied as Markdown.

### Purge
import { Purge } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A purge button for the site's own items in your browser. One press runs a short "wipe", removes only the keys that belong to this site, and shows what is left (which should be nothing of ours).
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### RandomRead
import { RandomRead } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Can't choose? A reel of the guide titles spins and lands on one. It is a dice with manners: it never lands on the same one twice in a row.
props: tag, title, lede, keys=[], onward

import { ReadingList } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Build a reading list from the pages of this site: tick what to read, or start from a preset; the list comes out as Markdown with the links and an honest estimate of the time, ready to send to someone.

### ReviewDraw
import { ReviewDraw } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A deck of the principles. Draw one and it turns up with a single question to put to your next design review — the principle as something to ask, not something to admire.

### RoleLens
import { RoleLens } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
One record, four people. Each role needs a few of the fields and not the rest. Choose a role and the record rearranges itself: what they need is sharp, what they do not is tucked away but never gone. An invented record, for illustration.
props: tag, title, lede, record=[], roles=[], onward

### ScopeTarget
import { ScopeTarget } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A target for a vulnerability-reporting scope: the bullseye is what is in scope, the rings outside it are what is not. Hover or focus a ring (or pick it from the list) to read what sits in it.
props: tag, title, lede, rings=[], onward

### SelfAudit
import { SelfAudit } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Four checks you run yourself, on this page, in your browser. Each says what it will look at, then what it found — so "trust us" becomes "look".
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### SigilMaker
import { SigilMaker } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A figure drawn from a word. The same word always draws the same shape, so it is a signature rather than a random picture. Download it as an SVG.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### SizeUp
import { SizeUp } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
How big is it, really? Five questions about a system, each a judgement, and the page says what shape of work that adds up to: a focused tool, a platform or a programme, with what changes at each size.
props: tag, title, lede, questions=[], bands=[], onward

### SpotTheBug
import { SpotTheBug } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A review exercise. Read a short piece of code the way a reviewer would, mark the lines you would stop, and press Check. Each real problem comes back with why it matters; lines flagged without cause are named too.
props: tag, title, lede, lang='javascript', lines=[], onward

### StateSheet
import { StateSheet } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
The seven states every control owns, shown side by side for three controls, and a live row of the real thing underneath. Tab to it, press it, hover it: the states above are what you are feeling.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### StatusLedger
import { StatusLedger } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
An honest ledger of where each document stands. The ticks arrive one by one as the ledger scrolls in; the column nobody has ticked yet says so.

Plan the end while you are building the start. Choose what applies to the system you are retiring and how much notice people get; out comes an ordered plan counted back from the day it is switched off.

Start from what is going wrong, not from what the team is called. Choose the symptom closest to yours and the page names the discipline that deals with it, why, and where else to look.

### TermsCard

The terms on a single card that turns over: what you can do on one side, what not to lean on on the other. Tilts toward the pointer; the flip is a button, so it works without one.

### ToastBench
import { ToastBench } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Fire the feedback components and watch what each one would announce.

### TokenPlayground
import { TokenPlayground } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Change four tokens and watch a small interface follow. The values are set on the preview alone, as custom properties — which is exactly how a real design system restyles everything at once.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### TrySite
import { TrySite } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Five things worth trying on this site, each a real control: they open the actual search, the actual shortcuts panel, the actual blueprint mode, the actual calm setting, and a page chosen at random. A way to end by using it.
props: tag, title, lede, onward

### WhatIfRemove
import { WhatIfRemove } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Pull one part out of the stack and see what goes with it. A way of asking how much each dependency really carries. The judgements are ours; the file counts were taken when the page was written.
props: tag, title, lede, parts=[], onward

### WhichOne
import { WhichOne } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Three questions, one recommendation. Answer them about the job in front of you and the helper names the trigger that fits — and why the other two don't.
props: tag, title, lede, questions=[], outcomes={}, onward

### WizardRun
import { WizardRun } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
A four-step flow, walked. The Stepper shows where you are; Next is held back until the step is complete and says why;
props: tag, title, lede, steps=[], onward

### WorkCompare
import { WorkCompare } from 'hanoryx-components/closers';
Put any two of the four side by side. The rows are the things the work pages say; where a row is the same for both it is marked, because what two pieces of work share is as telling as how they differ.
props: tag, title, lede, shows={}, onward

import { ShowcaseIndex } from 'hanoryx-components/stage';
/showcase — the index of the showcase. An opening screen with a mosaic of every page; then the pages by chapter beside a pinned dial that turns to the chapter being read; then every stage, each with the pages that use it.

import { ShowcaseIntro } from 'hanoryx-components/stage';

import { CanvasStage } from 'hanoryx-components/stage';
CANVAS STAGES — the page is a sheet, not a column. The specimens sit on a big flat plane and the scroll flies a camera between them (camera.js): it rests on one, pulls back until the way to the next is in view, swings across — left, right,…
