props: Visual

## Core

### useAudioAnalyzer (core/hooks)
import { useAudioAnalyzer } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Drives a small canvas visualizer from real frequency data. Only runs the shared rAF loop while audio is playing; draws a single static frame when paused (no perpetual loop). DPR-capped, cleaned up on unmount.
returns: No return value. Paints the attached canvas using the AudioProvider analyser.

### useCopy (core/hooks)
import { useCopy } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Copy-to-clipboard with a short "copied" state for the button label.
returns: [copied, copy]. copied is the last copied string or false. await copy(text) returns whether copying succeeded.

### useDocumentTitle (core/hooks)
import { useDocumentTitle } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Sets the document title for a page (external sync — not React state). Pass the page label; the base brand is appended automatically.
returns: No return value. Updates the document title and optional description when arguments change.

### useElementInView (core/hooks)
import { useElementInView } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
IntersectionObserver wrapper for cheap "is this on screen" reveals.
returns: [ref, inView]. once defaults to true; with once:false visibility keeps toggling.

### useMediaQuery (core/hooks)
import { useMediaQuery } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Subscribes to a CSS media query without effect-driven state (so it is safe under the React 19 lint rules and never causes a cascading render).
returns: Boolean matching the supplied query. serverDefault is used during server rendering.

### useFinePointer (core/hooks)
import { useFinePointer } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
True for a mouse / trackpad (hover-capable, precise). Touch gets simpler, tap-first behaviour.
returns: Boolean: true only for a hover-capable fine pointer.

### useOnScreen (core/hooks)
import { useOnScreen } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Tracks whether an element is on screen. Unlike useElementInView (one-shot reveals) this keeps toggling, so loops, canvases and infinite animations can pause the moment they scroll away. State is only set from the observer callback.
returns: [ref, onScreen]. Attach ref to one element; onScreen follows every intersection change.

### usePageCatalog (core/hooks)
import { usePageCatalog } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Loads shared page metadata only while a catalog-backed control is mounted.
returns: {catalog, error, retry}. catalog starts null; configureSite must register loadPageCatalog.

### usePointerField (core/hooks)
import { usePointerField } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Writes the pointer's position INSIDE an element to CSS variables, so any descendant can respond with pure CSS (transforms, gradients, parallax).
returns: No return value. Writes --px/--py, --mx/--my and data-hot on the attached element.

### usePrefersReducedMotion (core/hooks)
import { usePrefersReducedMotion } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Reactively tracks the user's reduced-motion preference. Components use this to gate or simplify expensive animation.
returns: Boolean reflecting the prefers-reduced-motion media query.

### useProximity (core/hooks)
import { useProximity } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Pointer-proximity engine. Finds every `[data-prox]` unit inside `ref` and keeps a CSS variable --k (0..1) on each: 1 under the cursor, easing to 0 at `radius` px (smoothstep falloff).
returns: No return value. Writes --k on each [data-prox] descendant; disabled for touch and reduced motion.

### AnimationProvider (core/providers)
import { AnimationProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Top-level animation environment. Registers GSAP plugins, sets global defaults, and keeps ScrollTrigger measurements honest across viewport changes and font loading.
props: children

### AudioProvider (core/providers)
import { AudioProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Owns the ambient <audio> element and a single Web Audio graph (MediaElementSource -> AnalyserNode -> destination). The graph is built lazily on the first user gesture (autoplay-safe) and reused for the session.
props: children, src

### ExperienceProvider (core/providers)
import { ExperienceProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
ExperienceProvider — owns the full-screen System Synthesis takeover. Opening it pauses every page scene, stops Lenis, locks scroll, and hides the nav/cursor (via the `synthesis-active` document class).
props: children

### HanoryxProvider (core/providers)
import { HanoryxProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Everything a Hanoryx page expects above it, in the order the site mounts it: animation environment (GSAP plugins) -> audio -> smooth scroll -> experience (the full-screen synthesis takeover).
props: children, smoothScroll=true, audio=true, experience=true, audioSrc

### LenisProvider (core/providers)
import { LenisProvider } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Smooth, "river-like" scrolling via Lenis, wired into the GSAP ticker so ScrollTrigger and Lenis share one clock. Disabled entirely under reduced-motion (native scroll takes over).
props: children

### useAudio (core/providers)
import { useAudio } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
useAudio: {status,isPlaying,start,stop,toggle,bins,getFrequencyData,available}. start() resolves a boolean and must follow a user gesture.
returns: {status,isPlaying,start,stop,toggle,bins,getFrequencyData,available}. start() resolves a boolean and must follow a user gesture.

### useExperience (core/providers)
import { useExperience } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
useExperience: {isSynthesisOpen,openSynthesis,closeSynthesis}. Requires ExperienceProvider for a working overlay.
returns: {isSynthesisOpen,openSynthesis,closeSynthesis}. Requires ExperienceProvider for a working overlay.

### useLenis (core/providers)
import { useLenis } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
useLenis: {scrollTo,stop,start,getLenis}. The instance is owned and cleaned up by LenisProvider.
returns: {scrollTo,stop,start,getLenis}. The instance is owned and cleaned up by LenisProvider.

### setAudioActive (core/motion)
import { setAudioActive } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
AUDIO BRIDGE — a single shared snapshot of the live audio spectrum that any canvas scene can read without subscribing to the React audio context.

### writeAudioBytes (core/motion)
import { writeAudioBytes } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Fold raw analyser bytes (any length) into BANDS normalised values.

### getAudio (core/motion)
import { getAudio } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Stable reference — scenes read fields each frame.

### resolveQuality (core/motion)
import { resolveQuality } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Resolve the quality a scene should run at, given its declared cost. cost: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'hero' -> 'static' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'

### maxActiveScenes (core/motion)
import { maxActiveScenes } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
How many background canvases may ANIMATE at once. Everything else holds a static frame. This is the primary defence against "every page lags": no matter how many scenes a page declares, only the most-visible few run.

### sceneFrameInterval (core/motion)
import { sceneFrameInterval } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Target frame interval (ms) for background scenes — backgrounds run at ~30fps regardless of a 60/120Hz display; halves/quarters draw work, invisibly.

RAF SCHEDULER — one requestAnimationFrame loop for the whole app. Scenes and loops subscribe with a callback (time, delta).

Register a scene controller. @param {{ratio:number, running:boolean, run:(on:boolean)=>void}} ctrl @returns {() => void} unregister

### copyText (core/utils)
import { copyText } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Copy text to the clipboard. Uses the async Clipboard API where the browser allows it, and a hidden textarea where it does not (older browsers, or a page that is not a secure context). Resolves to whether it worked.

### downloadText (core/utils)
import { downloadText } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Save text as a file the visitor downloads. Nothing leaves the browser: the file is built in memory and handed to a temporary link.

### contrastRatio (core/utils)
import { contrastRatio } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
The WCAG contrast ratio of two colours, from 1 (identical) to 21 (black on white).

### nearestPassing (core/utils)
import { nearestPassing } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
The closest colour to `fg` (changing only its lightness) that reaches `target` against `bg`, looking both darker and lighter. Returns { darker, lighter }, either of which may be null.

### parseCron (core/utils)

Marks a foreground detail so it can be inventoried and (in blueprint mode) labelled. `fx('home.orbit')` spreads `data-fx="home.orbit"` onto an element. It has no runtime cost beyond the attribute.

### changesIn (core/utils)
import { changesIn } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
Every clock change a zone makes in a year, found by watching the offset day by day. Each result: { at, before, after, y, m, d } where y/m/d is the local date of the change.

### effectOn (core/utils)
import { effectOn } from 'hanoryx-components/core';
What `HH:MM` does on the local day of a clock change: 0 = it never happens, 1 = once, 2 = twice.
